en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a stately multi-story building with turreted architecture and a sign reading 'Libortushaus.' The setting is a curved street with trees and a stone wall, giving the impression of a picturesque and tranquil location. The bottom of the image has caption text identifying the scene as 'Bad Pyrmont - Libortushaus.' The reverse side includes handwritten correspondence in German, a green postage stamp, and postmarks. There is also a museum logo and the printed address of a museum in Bad Pyrmont.
